title: Dev-M / Delete old data / List have double entries
body:
I just cleaned the AAPS database. Once finished, I have the list of the deleted data. Up to that point, all is ok.

The list has some lines doubled. Everything up to _UserEntry_ starts again at the end of the list. Strange part is that the numbers are not the same when shown a second time...
